meta: AI-powered products, from rice cookers to toothbrushes: read the ads with a clear head, since it's often just an auto mode that's existed for years.

muc.title: Everything has AI
muc.text: From rice cookers to toothbrushes, everything says AI-powered, but often it's just an auto mode that's existed for years.

muc.title: What does the AI actually do
muc.text: Look in the ad for one sentence saying exactly what the AI does. If you can't find it, the word AI may just be there to sell.

muc.title: What do you get for paying more
muc.text: Compare with the non-AI version. Ask a chatbot to compare the published specs; don't just read the slogan.

muc.title: What the device collects
muc.text: AI devices often need internet and an account. Read the privacy section to see what data it collects in your home.

muc.title: Inspect one description
muc.text: Paste the description of a product labeled AI-powered and ask a chatbot which features are real.
